rationale.conceptual: The method is established (DFT with PBE, phonon dispersion via Phonopy, stress–strain analysis) but applying it across many candidate structures and strain directions requires careful implementation of a multi-part, documented protocol. Orchestrating Quantum ESPRESSO and Phonopy, managing input/output, and parsing results for mechanical/band properties is a long and fragile multi-stage process with many load-bearing handoffs.
